metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Album Cover Layout
useCases: Poster design with high-contrast color blocking

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy mid-century layout featuring a central dynamic figure against a solid vibrant background framed by a thick contrasting border and heavy condensed typography.
triggerTerms: vibrant pink and orange color block

recipe.visualDefinition: A central full-body figure in a dynamic, jumping pose is set against a solid, saturated pink field. The entire composition is framed by a thick orange border with black vertical bars on the sides. Large, vertically-stacked condensed sans-serif text occupies the upper left, while a list of smaller text is aligned to the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with dynamic upward movement
Heavy title block balanced by a lighter tracklist column
Vibrant pink field contrasted by a warm orange outer frame
Black vertical sidebars providing structural grounding
coreInvariants: Thick orange outer border with black vertical sidebars
Vertically stacked condensed sans-serif display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject centered, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height in a jumping pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white-filled condensed title block in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the title block to the subject's raised hand, down through the body, and over to the tracklist on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open pink space around the subject to emphasize the energy of the pose.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary fields with high value contrast between white text and dark clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales and weights for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule at bottom for metadata

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence of the title.
Provides the mid-century grotesque feel with appropriate width.
Classic 1960s condensed sans-serif often used in music packaging.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body photo of a person in a dynamic jumping pose wearing a 1960s-style suit, centered on a solid vibrant pink background. Frame the image with a thick orange border and black vertical bars on the left and right edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay extra-condensed bold sans-serif text in white with a thin black outline in the upper left corner, stacked vertically. Add a list of smaller white condensed sans-serif text aligned to the right margin.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated pink?
Is the title text extra-condensed and stacked on the left?
Is there a thick orange border around the entire composition?
Is the subject in a dynamic, energetic pose?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange border is uniform and includes black sidebars.
Verify the title text is white with a black outline.
Ensure the subject does not overlap the primary title text.
Confirm the pink background is a flat, solid color without gradients.
Check that the tracklist is right-aligned and legible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dynamic subject + Solid vibrant field + Thick contrasting border + Stacked condensed sans-serif typography.
